lullabyofthenewmoon.notification.blue_mo: The "Blue Moon" rises... Luck, XP, and enchanting favor you.
The "Blue Moon" sets... Your luck fades.
lullabyofthenewmoon.notification.super_b: The "Super Blue Moon" rises... Fortune overflows. XP soars and costs drop.
The "Super Blue Moon" sets... Your fortune fades.
lullabyofthenewmoon.notification.eternal: The "Eternal Moon" rises... Your crops provide a better harvest.
lullabyofthenewmoon.notification.super_e: The "Super Eternal Moon" rises... Your crops provide an exceptional harvest.
lullabyofthenewmoon.notification.frost_m: The "Frost Moon" rises... The night turns quiet. Few monsters stir.
The "Frost Moon" sets... The cold lifts.
lullabyofthenewmoon.notification.super_f: The "Super Frost Moon" rises... Monsters vanish and a cold calm shields you.
The "Super Frost Moon" sets... The calm fades.
lullabyofthenewmoon.notification.iridesc: The "Iridescent Moon" rises... The night shimmers. Something feels different.
The "Iridescent Moon" sets... The shimmer fades.
